title: Mushroom country
description: A mod that adds a large number of mushrooms. It will diversify your Minecraft world!
body: This mod pack significantly expands the ecosystem of virtual biomes by introducing a wide range of mushroom forms, including chanterelles, panther mushrooms, and many others, which are distributed throughout various parts of the game world. The mod also provides players with the opportunity to cook these mushroom species, particularly by preparing stews, which opens up new possibilities for gameplay and environmental interaction. This mod will enhance your gaming experience! The stews from the mod can grant you temporary abilities, which can help you fight monsters by increasing your physical capabilities.
